title: Direct-child forwarding path (route.len()==1) forwards verbatim with no Hop Limit decrement
description: Found by 3x codereview of b7z9.4.1 (passes: correctness + edge-cases). In Gateway::mesh_to_mesh (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs ~1645-1646), a packet for a direct RPL child (route.len()==1) is forwarded verbatim: no RFC 8200 forwarding decrement, no HL<=1 discard. After b7z9.4.1 the tunnel path (indirect children) correctly applies the forwarding decrement + Segments-Left charge, making the two forwarding paths of the same function mutually inconsistent. Note: pre-existing, outside R-05-066 scope (no SRH/tunnel on the direct-child path); decide whether the normal forwarding decrement applies there and add tests (HL=1 arrival must be dropped per RFC 8200 sec 5.3). Same question applies to the link-local verbatim path (~1630). Files: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.4.1.
